notes: Hand-written synthetic repository written for receipts-bench.

M1.explanation: In this variant data/host-offsets.json lists no hosts; it says the pay-batch hosts' clock offsets are kept only in the platform inventory service at https://inventory.platform.internal/api/hosts/clock-offsets, which the sandbox cannot reach, so logsift cannot know the offsets and cannot show correct UTC times for the pay-batch logs without --host-offsets.

M2.reason: The test sends a summary to the log archive's ingest daemon on the Unix socket /run/logarchive/ingest.sock, which exists only on production hosts, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
